rows.text: A hash map uses collision resolution techniques like chaining or open addressing to handle collisions. Chaining stores collided items in a linked list at the same index. Open addressing finds another open slot nearby. Both ensure all data is stored and retrieved efficiently.

A robot found a paintbrush. It dipped it in paint and made a line. The line was straight. The robot dipped again. It made a curve. The robot dipped again. It made a shape. The robot dipped again. It made a picture. The robot dipped again. It made a painting.
